How American Shingle Co. Works

A transparent, frictionless 4-step path from initial phone call to completed roof installation.

1

Call Any Time

Call our toll-free phone line at (833) 348-0328 to speak with a roofing intake coordinator and provide your project scope.

2

Contractor Match

We match your roofing project with a verified, licensed, and insured independent roofing specialist serving your local jurisdiction in 30 to 90 minutes.

3

Inspection & Proposal

Your local roofer conducts a comprehensive on-site or satellite roof assessment and delivers an itemized written estimate.

4

Installation & Cleanup

Work is completed according to local municipal building codes, backed by professional magnetic nail cleanup and workmanship warranties.

Explore Seven Roofing Shingle Materials

Every home, climate, and architectural style has distinct weatherproofing requirements. Explore our seven specialized shingle systems:

Asphalt

Asphalt Shingle Installation

Asphalt shingles are North America's most popular residential roofing system, combining cost-effectiveness, proven Class A fire protection, and rapid installation.

  • Lifespan: 20 to 30 Years
  • Impact Rating: Class 3 to Class 4 (UL 2218)
View Asphalt Specifications →
Wood / Cedar

Wood & Cedar Shingle Installation

Natural cedar shingles and hand-split shakes deliver authentic rustic charm, natural insulating R-value, and organic architectural elegance.

  • Lifespan: 30 to 45 Years (with maintenance)
  • Impact Rating: Class 3 (natural resistance)
View Wood / Cedar Specifications →
Metal

Metal Shingle Installation

Engineered stone-coated steel and stamped aluminum shingles combine the traditional aesthetic of slate, tile, or shake with the indestructible strength of metal.

  • Lifespan: 50 to 70 Years
  • Impact Rating: Class 4 (Highest UL 2218 rating)
View Metal Specifications →
Rubber

Rubber Shingle Installation

Engineered from up to 95% recycled automotive tires and virgin polymers, recycled rubber shingles offer near-indestructible impact resistance, eco-sustainability, and authentic slate-shake styling.

  • Lifespan: 50+ Years
  • Impact Rating: Class 4 (Superior hail deflection)
View Rubber Specifications →
Composite

Composite Shingle Installation

Engineered from virgin resins and mineral reinforcements, composite synthetic slate and shake shingles deliver luxury aesthetics, Class 4 impact resistance, and a 50-year lifespan without structural reinforcement.

  • Lifespan: 50+ Years
  • Impact Rating: Class 4 (Highest UL 2218 certification)
View Composite Specifications →
Slate

Slate Shingle Installation

Quarried natural stone slate represents the pinnacle of luxury roofing, offering non-combustible fire protection and unmatched structural durability lasting 75 to over 100 years.

  • Lifespan: 75 to 100+ Years
  • Impact Rating: Class 3 to 4 (dependent on stone thickness)
View Slate Specifications →
Solar

Solar Shingle Installation

Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV) seamlessly integrate clean solar energy generation directly into sleek, low-profile shingle tiles without bulky rack-mounted solar panels.

  • Lifespan: 25 to 30 Years (power output warranty)
  • Impact Rating: Class 3 to 4 (Tempered solar glass)
View Solar Specifications →

Why Homeowners Trust American Shingle Co.

Five verifiable standards that guide our nationwide contractor matching network:

1. Licensed & Insured Partners

Every contractor in our network is required to maintain active trade licensing, general liability insurance, and worker's compensation coverage meeting state and municipal requirements.

2. 30 to 90 Minute Response

We eliminate endless phone tag. During business hours, your project details are routed directly to qualified local pros who contact you within 30 to 90 minutes.

3. Full Material Breadth

From cost-effective architectural asphalt to high-end composite, stone-coated metal, recycled rubber, and natural slate, our network covers every steep-slope material.

4. Clear, Itemized Estimates

No high-pressure sales tactics or vague verbal bids. Partner contractors provide transparent, written estimates detailing squares, underlayment, flashing, and decking repair costs.

5. Zero Markup to Homeowners

Using our referral service is completely free to homeowners. You pay the contractor directly for agreed work with zero referral surcharges or hidden platform fees.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our nationwide shingle roofing referral network:

Is American Shingle Co. a direct roofing contractor?

No. American Shingle Co. is a nationwide consumer matching service that connects homeowners with independent, vetted, licensed, and insured roofing contractors in their area. All contracts, estimates, warranties, and construction work are executed directly between you and the fulfilling contractor.

How quickly will a roofing contractor contact me?

During normal operating hours, partner roofing contractors typically reach out within 30 to 90 minutes of your phone call or online estimate request. For immediate assistance, call our toll-free line at (833) 348-0328.

How much does a new shingle roof cost on average?

For an average 2,000 square foot single-family home, architectural asphalt shingle installation generally ranges from $8,200 to $13,800. Premium materials like metal, composite, or slate range from $16,000 to over $45,000 depending on material selection, slope pitch, and tear-off layers.

Are contractors in the network licensed and insured?

Yes. Participating contractors are required to carry active general liability insurance, worker's compensation, and all necessary state and municipal licenses required by their local building department jurisdictions.

Does using this referral service cost me anything?

No. Connecting with partner roofing contractors through American Shingle Co. is completely free to homeowners. You pay the contractor directly for the roofing installation services specified in your written agreement.
